name: OpenTools

sources.title: Launch tool page — 'Tool submissions require a paid listing subscription'; sign-in then checkout
OpenTools homepage — AI tools directory and newsletter

requirements: AI tool product aimed at an AI-enthusiast audience
Paid listing subscription is mandatory — the page states tool submissions require payment
Sign-in is required before entering tool details and continuing to checkout
Package includes: listing on the site (dofollow backlink), 4 days on the homepage, and launch posts on OpenTools' X/Twitter (23k) and LinkedIn (5k)
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, logo/screenshots for the listing and social posts
Budget for the paid listing subscription (price shown only after sign-in)
Launch window preference — the package runs as a coordinated launch (homepage days + social posts)
workflow: Click 'Sign In to Continue' and authenticate
Enter tool details in the gated form
Continue to checkout and pay the listing subscription
Coordinate launch timing with the OpenTools team (their testimonials describe a hands-on, communicative process)
Tool appears on the site, 4 days on homepage, plus launch posts on X and LinkedIn
watchFor: Price is not shown publicly — it only appears after sign-in
It is a 'listing subscription', i.e. recurring — check billing terms inside checkout before paying
The page is heavy on testimonials and traffic claims (782.89k uniques/mo, DA 70) — treat metrics as marketing
Newsletter exposure is mentioned in stats but the base package lists website + social posts; confirm what's included at checkout
countsAsLive: Tool has a public listing page on opentools.ai and appears on the homepage during its 4-day feature window
unknowns: Exact subscription price and billing period (behind sign-in)
Whether newsletter inclusion is part of the base package or an upsell
What happens to the listing if the subscription lapses
